items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: I called Nat and he come over there and got us and we went back

ctx.x: I says, "No, I'm going to get you a yard." He said, "Are you kidding?" I said, "I'll get you a yard," I said, "just be ready and I'll call Nat." I called Nat and he come over there and got us and we went back and Buster wrote that -- wrote a hell of a lot of arrangements. Man, you should have heard that band.

So he finally -- but he finally left and went on back to Bennie Moten and about time they got back -- and Basie was the last one to leave. He went on back to Bennie Moten, too, you know. Bennie started getting some jobs. They went into a club called the Harlem Club in Kansas City.
